description:
Estimated kilograms of methylamphetamine, cocaine, MDMA and heroin consumed each financial year from 2016-17 to 2024-25, for Australia and each state and territory, measured from sewage. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: Australia and all 8 states and territories; financial years 2016-17 to 2024-25. Current to 2025-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/drug-use`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: meth_kg, cocaine_kg, mdma_kg, heroin_kg, total_kg. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: australia_health_drug_use
title: Australia · Illicit drug consumption (wastewater)
